intended_object: The meet (common refinement) of two admissible finite quotients of the abstract free product ∗ᵢ Gᵢ. On kernels this is the intersection N ∩ M of two finite-index normal subgroups whose preimages in each factor Gᵢ are open. Inferred from the docstring and from its use as `inf` in the `SemilatticeInf` instance.
explanation:
The definition faithfully gives the meet of two admissible quotients.

**Underlying subgroup.** It is `U ⊓ V` in `FiniteIndexNormalSubgroup`. In Mathlib this is the subgroup intersection; Mathlib proves it is still normal and of finite index.

**Admissibility.** The proof shows that the preimage of the intersection under each `CoprodI.of` is the intersection of the two preimages. Each preimage is open, so their intersection is open. Hence the result is again admissible.

**Order.** In the partial order lifted from `FiniteIndexNormalSubgroup`, this is the greatest lower bound, as the `SemilatticeInf` instance right after it confirms. That is exactly the common refinement of two finite quotients used to make the diagram of admissible quotients cofiltered.

**Generality.** Mathlib has no free profinite product, so there is no counterpart. The setting (profinite factors, abstract free product) is the natural one for this construction.
